Prima & Timo — Album 6: Nonaginta Octo

Vellum

"Ancient book of ages past"

[Library ambience + soft glowing hum] [Verse 1] Back in the library, the books whispered low The glowing Book Three opened, a voice from long ago “What age is this?” it asked, calm but full of years Timo answered gently, trying to calm his fears

“Not sure how to answer, but I am human, she’s a mermaid true I have friends outside — Toes and Kai, a toaster and submarine too We are in Waterland, seeking answers deep” The voice paused, then spoke again, ancient and deep [Pre-Chorus] “I feel you are half of a whole… this is Age thirty four But why was I awoken? I feel I am lacking more” [Chorus — wondrous & mysterious] Vellum Ancient book of ages past Vellum Memories that stretch so vast I am incomplete now, only one of twelve I see Find the rest of me… so I can set you free [Verse 2] “I am Vellum,” the voice continued, gentle but reserved “I know the entire history, but some things stay preserved Unless all twelve are gathered, I can’t reveal it all Ask too deep and I will say… no comment, or I plead the fifth, that’s all”

Timo listened closely, heart beating in his chest “We need to know about the cores, about the hand off quest” Vellum replied softly, “I know where four others lie The rest are hidden… almost intentionally, I sigh” [Pre-Chorus 2] “Then we shall find them,” Timo said with quiet fire Vellum glowed brighter, “You may take me on your journey, sire” [Chorus — wondrous & mysterious] Vellum Ancient book of ages past Vellum Memories that stretch so vast I am incomplete now, only one of twelve I see Find the rest of me… so I can set you free [Bridge — hopeful] They left the library, book in hand, ready for the road To ask the King for permission… and carry this heavy load [solo] [Coda] This may be what I need so I need to ask permission from the king To bring Vellum with me and find more answers and continue adventuring Toes and Kai will be ready, we have so much to do now we need to prepare And be ready to find answers or questions, maybe more than we dare
